## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Fix duplicate adoption output so the new plan records preserve the command’s existing progress behavior.

## Changes

The planner now returns adoption records and an audit record with the incoming settings count. New tests check that empty and nonempty plans return audit records without printing them.

## Important

- app/planner.py:9 — correctness — Emit adoption progress once per setting — When `theme` appears in both current and incoming settings, the planner emits `Adopted theme` immediately, then returns the same message in a record that `run` prints at `app/cli.py:9`. — Users see two apparent adoption events for each setting the command adopts. — Fix: Extend the filter at `app/cli.py:7` to skip adoption records and extend `test_adoption_progress` to cover `run`.
